use crate::misc;
use crate::misc::gityas_myers::{DiffHunk, EditType};
use anyhow::Result;
use git2::Diff;
use gityas_domain::models::file::{
    ConflictChunk, ConflictType, GitYasConflict, GitYasDelta, GitYasDeltaChange, GitYasDiff, GitYasHunk,
};
use std::cell::RefCell;
use std::ops::Deref;
use std::path::Path;

pub fn get_commit_file_diff(
    repo: &git2::Repository,
    commit_id: Option<String>,
    gityas_delta: GitYasDelta,
    is_staged: Option<bool>,
) -> Result<GitYasDiff> {
    if let Some(commit_id) = commit_id.as_ref() {
        return get_commit_diff(repo, commit_id, gityas_delta);
    }

    let is_staged = is_staged.unwrap_or(false);
    let mut diff_opts = git2::DiffOptions::new();
    diff_opts.context_lines(3).pathspec(gityas_delta.file_path.clone());

    let (old_content, new_content, hunks) = if gityas_delta.change_type == GitYasDeltaChange::UNTRACKED {
        let new_content = get_file_content_at_workdir(repo, &effective_path(&gityas_delta))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        (
            String::new(),
            new_content.clone(),
            synthesize_hunks(&new_content),
        )
    } else if is_staged {
        let head_tree = get_head_tree_or_empty(repo)?;
        let index = repo.index()?;
        let diff: Diff = repo.diff_tree_to_index(Some(&head_tree), Some(&index), Some(&mut diff_opts))?;

        let old_content = get_file_content_at_tree(repo, &head_tree, &effective_old_path(&gityas_delta))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let new_content = get_file_content_at_index(repo, &effective_new_path(&gityas_delta))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        (old_content, new_content, collect_hunks(&diff)?)
    } else {
        let diff: Diff = repo.diff_index_to_workdir(None, Some(&mut diff_opts))?;

        let old_content = get_file_content_at_index(repo, &effective_old_path(&gityas_delta))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        let new_content = get_file_content_at_workdir(repo, &effective_new_path(&gityas_delta))
            .unwrap_or_default();
        (old_content, new_content, collect_hunks(&diff)?)
    };

    Ok(GitYasDiff {
        old_content,
        new_content,
        hunks,
    })
}

fn get_commit_diff(
    repo: &git2::Repository,
    commit_id: &str,
    gityas_delta: GitYasDelta,
) -> Result<GitYasDiff> {
    let commit = repo.find_commit(git2::Oid::from_str(commit_id)?)?;
    let tree = commit.tree()?;
    let mut diff_opts = git2::DiffOptions::new();
    diff_opts.context_lines(3).pathspec(gityas_delta.file_path.clone());

    let parent_tree = if commit.parent_count() > 0 {
        commit.parent(0)?.tree()?
    } else {
        repo.find_tree(git2::Oid::from_str("4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904").unwrap())?
    };

    let diff: Diff = repo.diff_tree_to_tree(Some(&parent_tree), Some(&tree), Some(&mut diff_opts))?;
    let old_content =
        get_file_content_at_tree(repo, &parent_tree, &effective_old_path(&gityas_delta)).unwrap_or_default();
    let new_content = get_file_content_at_tree(repo, &tree, &effective_new_path(&gityas_delta)).unwrap_or_default();
    let hunks = collect_hunks(&diff)?;

    Ok(GitYasDiff {
        old_content,
        new_content,
        hunks,
    })
}

fn collect_hunks(diff: &Diff) -> Result<Vec<GitYasHunk>, git2::Error> {
    let mut hunks = Vec::new();
    let current_hunk = RefCell::new(None::<GitYasHunk>);

    diff.foreach(
        &mut |_, _| true,
        None,
        Some(&mut |_delta, hunk| {
            if let Some(hunk) = current_hunk.borrow_mut().take() {
                hunks.push(hunk);
            }

            *current_hunk.borrow_mut() = Some(GitYasHunk {
                old_start: hunk.old_start(),
                old_lines: hunk.old_lines(),
                new_start: hunk.new_start(),
                new_lines: hunk.new_lines(),
            });
            true
        }),
        None,
    )?;

    if current_hunk.borrow().deref().is_some() {
        let hunk = current_hunk.borrow().clone().unwrap();
        hunks.push(hunk);
    }

    Ok(hunks)
}

fn get_file_content_at_tree(
    repo: &git2::Repository,
    tree: &git2::Tree,
    path: &str,
) -> Result<String, git2::Error> {
    match tree.get_path(Path::new(path)) {
        Ok(entry) => {
            let blob = repo.find_blob(entry.id())?;
            let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(blob.content()).to_string();
            Ok(content)
        }
        Err(e) => Err(e),
    }
}

fn get_file_content_at_index(repo: &git2::Repository, path: &str) -> Result<String, git2::Error> {
    let index = repo.index()?;
    match index.get_path(Path::new(path), 0) {
        Some(entry) => {
            let blob = repo.find_blob(entry.id)?;
            let content = String::from_utf8_lossy(blob.content()).to_string();
            Ok(content)
        }
        None => Err(git2::Error::from_str("Index entry not found")),
    }
}

fn get_file_content_at_workdir(repo: &git2::Repository, path: &str) -> Result<String> {
    // Get the absolute path to the file
    let repo_workdir = repo.workdir().ok_or(git2::Error::from_str(
        "Not a standard repository with a working directory",
    ))?;
    let absolute_file_path = repo_workdir.join(path);
    // Read the file content directly from the filesystem
    let content = std::fs::read_to_string(absolute_file_path)?;
    Ok(content)
}

fn get_head_tree_or_empty(repo: &git2::Repository) -> Result<git2::Tree<'_>, git2::Error> {
    match repo.head() {
        Ok(head) => head.peel_to_tree(),
        Err(err) if err.code() == git2::ErrorCode::UnbornBranch => repo.find_tree(
            git2::Oid::from_str("4b825dc642cb6eb9a060e54bf8d69288fbee4904")?,
        ),
        Err(err) => Err(err),
    }
}

fn effective_old_path(delta: &GitYasDelta) -> String {
    if delta.old_path.is_empty() {
        delta.file_path.clone()
    } else {
        delta.old_path.clone()
    }
}

fn effective_new_path(delta: &GitYasDelta) -> String {
    if delta.new_path.is_empty() {
        delta.file_path.clone()
    } else {
        delta.new_path.clone()
    }
}

fn effective_path(delta: &GitYasDelta) -> String {
    if !delta.new_path.is_empty() {
        delta.new_path.clone()
    } else {
        delta.file_path.clone()
    }
}

fn synthesize_hunks(content: &str) -> Vec<GitYasHunk> {
    let line_count = content.lines().count() as u32;

    if line_count == 0 {
        Vec::new()
    } else {
        vec![GitYasHunk {
            old_start: 0,
            old_lines: 0,
            new_start: 1,
            new_lines: line_count,
        }]
    }
}

pub fn get_merge_conflict_by_path(
    repo: &git2::Repository,
    path: &String,
) -> Result<GitYasConflict> {
    let mut index = repo.index()?;
    index.read(false)?;

    let conflict = index.conflict_get(std::path::Path::new(path))?;

    let ancestor = load_file_content_from_index_entry(conflict.ancestor, repo)
        .ok_or(git2::Error::from_str("No ancestor found"))?;
    let ours = load_file_content_from_index_entry(conflict.our, repo);
    let theirs = load_file_content_from_index_entry(conflict.their, repo);

    let mut deleted_file_return = GitYasConflict {
        ancestor: ancestor.clone(),
        ours: String::default(),
        theirs: String::default(),
        chunks: vec![],
        ours_deleted: false,
        theirs_deleted: false,
        auto_resolved: false,
    };

    if ours.is_none() && theirs.is_none() {
        deleted_file_return.auto_resolved = true;
        return Ok(deleted_file_return);
    }
    if ours.is_none() {
        deleted_file_return.ours_deleted = true;
        return Ok(deleted_file_return);
    }
    if theirs.is_none() {
        deleted_file_return.theirs_deleted = true;
        return Ok(deleted_file_return);
    }

    let conflict = get_conflicts_by_files(ancestor, ours.unwrap(), theirs.unwrap())?;
    Ok(conflict)
}

pub fn load_file_content_from_index_entry(
    entry: Option<git2::IndexEntry>,
    repo: &git2::Repository,
) -> Option<String> {
    if entry.is_none() {
        return None;
    }

    let blob = repo.find_blob(entry.unwrap().id);

    match blob {
        Ok(blob) => Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(blob.content()).into_owned()),
        Err(_) => Some(String::default()),
    }
}

pub fn get_conflicts_by_files(
    ancestor: String,
    ours: String,
    theirs: String,
) -> Result<GitYasConflict> {
    let ours_diffs: Vec<DiffHunk> =
        misc::gityas_myers::myers_diff(ancestor.clone().as_str(), ours.clone().as_str())
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|c| c.edit_type != EditType::Equal)
            .collect();
    let theirs_diffs: Vec<DiffHunk> =
        misc::gityas_myers::myers_diff(ancestor.clone().as_str(), theirs.clone().as_str())
            .into_iter()
            .filter(|c| c.edit_type != EditType::Equal)
            .collect();

    let merged = misc::gityas_merger::merge_non_conflicting_chunks(
        ancestor.as_str(),
        ours.as_str(),
        theirs.as_str(),
        ours_diffs,
        theirs_diffs,
    );
    let conflict_count = merged.conflicts.len();

    let conflict = GitYasConflict {
        ancestor: merged.merged_text,
        ours: ours,
        theirs: theirs,
        chunks: merged
            .conflicts
            .into_iter()
            .map(|chunk| {
                let (merged_ancestor_start, merged_ancestor_end) = chunk.merged_ancestor_range;
                let (ours_start, ours_end) = chunk.ours_range;
                let (theirs_start, theirs_end) = chunk.theirs_range;

                ConflictChunk {
                    conflict_type: ConflictType::Both,
                    ours_start: if ours_start == 0 {
                        ours_start
                    } else {
                        ours_start + 1
                    },
                    ours_end: if ours_start == ours_end && ours_end != 0 {
                        ours_start + 1
                    } else {
                        ours_end
                    },
                    theirs_start: if theirs_start == 0 {
                        theirs_start
                    } else {
                        theirs_start + 1
                    },
                    theirs_end: if theirs_start == theirs_end && theirs_end != 0 {
                        theirs_start + 1
                    } else {
                        theirs_end
                    },
                    ancestor_start: if merged_ancestor_start == 0 {
                        merged_ancestor_start
                    } else {
                        merged_ancestor_start + 1
                    },
                    ancestor_end: if merged_ancestor_start == merged_ancestor_end
                        && merged_ancestor_end != 0
                    {
                        merged_ancestor_start + 1
                    } else {
                        merged_ancestor_end
                    },
                }
            })
            .collect(),
        ours_deleted: false,
        theirs_deleted: false,
        auto_resolved: conflict_count == 0,
    };

    Ok(conflict)
}
